Date of Discovery: CVE-2016-10033, CVE-2016-10045 discovered in 2016, CVE-2017-11503 and CVE-2017-5223 discovered in 2017, CVE-2018-19296 discovered in 2018, CVE-2020-13625 discovered in 2020, CVE-2021-3603 discovered in 2021
Method of Attack: Arbitrary code execution, Cross-site scripting (XSS), Object injection, Unauthorized access and exposure of sensitive information
Discoverer: Dawid Golunski, Yongxiang Li, Sehun Oh, Elar Lang
Impacted Systems: Ubuntu 16.04 ESM, Ubuntu 18.04 ESM, Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS
Attack Vector: Improper handling of user input data, Oversight in escaping characters, Failure to appropriately convert relative paths, Inadequacy in processing untrusted non-local file attachments, Oversight in escaping file attachment names, Oversight in handling of callables
